name: 24 Nights of Advent
description: One guest behind each door of the advent calendar, from 1 to 24 December.

nights.note: The tomte has been on duty all year. The first door is his.
The sawing under the floorboards is getting louder.
The Belsnickel likes to call early, before anyone's ready.
The Alsace Christmas markets are open, and someone is lurking behind the stalls.
It's Krampusnacht, the eve of St Nicholas Day.
It's St Nicholas Day, and Father Whipper is a step behind the saint.
Two and a half weeks to get some new clothes.
It's the feast of the Immaculate Conception, when the Tió comes home to be fed.
Fifteen nights until Marley's anniversary.
Is the spinning done? It had better be by the Twelve Days.
Grýla is packing her sons off down the mountain.
Sheep-Cote Clod, the first Yule Lad, comes down tonight.
Practise your rhymes now. You'll need them by Christmas.
Eleven nights to go. It's pointing at the calendar.
Krampus is still out there, sharpening his switches for next year.
Five Yule Lads down the mountain, eight to come.
A week before Christmas: prime Belsnickel season.
Check the larder: is there enough butter for Christmas Eve?
A Christmas Carol was published on this day in 1843.
Nine sons arrived. Grýla is getting her pot ready.
The longest night of the year, and the saw has nearly reached the heart of the tree.
Two weeks of feeding. The Tió is looking well.
Tomorrow night is Scrooge's night. Whatever comes after is still up to him.
It's Christmas Eve. Hope you got new clothes.
